author: /root/restart_contact_field
claim: Actual quotient pointed model and operation morphisms with exact arbitrary-Scheme point transport

obligations.name: Hypotheses
obligations.binding: Generic actual Scheme iso e and precise Q/base square; concrete specialization supplies the canonical normalization iso and unit discriminant.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.binding: Original quotient normalization and literal completed rational target; actual relative product, not a surrogate point set.

obligations.name: Coverage
obligations.binding: Every i:Fin4; generic transport over any commutative coefficient ring and every Scheme test with its specified base map.

obligations.name: Maps
obligations.binding: Zero=infinity followed by iso inverse; negation=conjugated literal inverse; addition=actual relative-product map, literal addition and iso inverse.

obligations.name: Identity
obligations.binding: Canonical iso and original structureMap; arbitrary-test equivalence defined by postcomposition with the actual iso/inverse.

obligations.name: Coefficients
obligations.binding: Exact publishedA/publishedB and original unit discriminant, no Base N coefficient-family substitution.

obligations.name: Local/global conditions
obligations.binding: All operations are whole-Scheme maps; zero/base/involution/operation-comparison identities are direct categorical proofs.

obligations.name: Exceptional cases
obligations.binding: No affine-only restriction, deleted infinity or reducedness requirement for test schemes.

obligations.name: Consumer boundary
obligations.binding: Actual pointed model and operations ready; rational associativity, full group, source Jacobian, polarization and PEL remain separate.
